decision.observation: The farmer is on the clear mailbox-level path at 10:30 a.m. Saturday, with open dirt leading east toward the farm exit.
decision.hypothesis: Holding east from here should reach the bus stop road and continue toward Pelican Town.
decision.memory: Route to Willy: east through the bus stop; west of town take the southeast branch through the fountain square to the southern east–west road, then go east across the river before turning south. Avoid the wooded area directly south of town.
